## What's Changed
* Add the statistics module by @prpercival in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1277
* Fix CI on Rust 1.100 by @rewitt94 in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1318
* Support w+b mode with positional filesystem writes by @tomhoule in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1261
* Reject ASTs too deep to drop instead of overflowing the stack by @cetra3 in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1324
* Add UTF-8 string access benchmarks by @jaheba in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1306
* Skip grpcio on free-threaded CI instead of pinning ubuntu-24.04 by @rewitt94 in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1322
* ci: use ubuntu 24.04 for i686 docker, bump arm images by @davidhewitt in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1327
* Bump black from 26.5.1 to 26.10.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1334
* Bump opentelemetry-api from 1.41.1 to 1.45.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1333
* ci: add more dependabot jobs, apply grouping by @davidhewitt in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1335
* Unify string operations on PyStr by @davidhewitt in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1325
* Bump the github-actions group with 9 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1337
* Implement int.bit_length() and int.bit_count() by @gabrielhsc95 in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1326
* Share guarded dict/set copies and avoid redundant dict work by @jaheba in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1268
* Expose csv.__version__ = '1.0' by @gabrielhsc95 in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1342
* Expose the slice.indices(length) method by @gabrielhsc95 in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1323
* Bump the rust group with 45 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1340
* drop support for EOL Python 3.10 by @davidhewitt in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1343
* Support `from m import *` by @r3v2d0g in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1314
* clean up some duplicate / redundant dependencies by @davidhewitt in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1346
* Decode unknown wire exception names as `Exception` by @samuelcolvin in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1312
* Bump pillow from 12.3.0 to 13.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1349
* drop EOL node 20, build with node 26 by @davidhewitt in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1345
* bump PyO3 to 0.30, jiter to 0.19 by @davidhewitt in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1348
* Bump urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1353
* Bump anyio from 4.13.0 to 4.14.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1352
* Fix Decimal quotient finalization and boolean tuple digits by @jaheba in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1354
* Bump the rust group across 1 directory with 9 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1356
* Bump the javascript group across 2 directories with 24 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1338
* Bump source-map-js from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2 in /crates/monty-js by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1358
* Bump shell-quote from 1.10.0 to 1.12.0 in /crates/monty-js by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1357
* perf: fast-path scalar arithmetic, comparisons, and common builtin operations by @gabrielhsc95 in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1255
* add contributing guide by @davidhewitt in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1365
* ci: try to simplify PGO builds by @davidhewitt in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1368
* Support bytes(iterable) constructor by @gabrielhsc95 in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1341
* Types refactor and inheritance by @samuelcolvin in https://github.com/pydantic/monty/pull/1264
* Let browser consumers apply Trusted

detail.readme:
Monty

A secure Python sandbox, written in Rust, for code written by AI.

______________________________________________________________________ Monty avoids the latency, complexity and cost of a container based sandbox for running LLM generated code. It comes in two forms: **OSS Monty**, the MIT licensed Python 3.14 sandbox you install as a package, and [**Commercial Support**](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/commercial-support/server/), the server that runs the same sandbox behind a gRPC stream as a service. A new OSS Monty sandbox takes under **1ms** from a running pool (Commercial Support: about **2ms**) [compared to](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/reference/alternatives/) around **1500ms** for a sandbox service. Filesystem, environment variables and network do not exist inside the sandbox: it reaches the host only through the functions and mounts you pass in. **Documentation: [pydantic.dev/docs/monty](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/)** ## Install ```bash uv add pydantic-monty # Python npm install @pydantic/monty # JavaScript / TypeScript cargo add monty # Rust ``` [Commercial Support](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/commercial-support/server/) runs the same workers as a container image. ## Example The `code` string is what a model writes when asked how long a bar of chocolate could power a lightbulb: ```python from pydantic_monty import Monty code = """ kcal = nutrition('chocolate bar')['kcal'] hours = kcal * 4184 / (bulb_watts * 3600) print(f'a chocolate bar powers a {bulb_watts} W bulb for {hours:.1f} hours') """ with Monty() as pool: with pool.checkout() as session: session.feed_run( code, inputs={'bulb_watts': 10}, external_lookup={'nutrition': lambda food: {'kcal': 230}}, ) #> a chocolate bar powers a 10 W bulb for 26.7 hours ``` `nutrition` ran on the host and the sandbox saw only its return value. ## Documentation - [Introduction](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/) with the latency measurements - [Comparison to alternatives](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/reference/alternatives/): Docker, Pyodide, WASI, sandboxing services - Getting started with [Python](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/quickstart/python/), [JavaScript](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/quickstart/javascript/) or [Rust](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/quickstart/rust/) - [Security model](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/concepts/security/), [resource limits](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/concepts/resource-limits/), [snapshots](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/concepts/snapshots/), [the Python subset](https://pydantic.dev/docs/monty/limitations/) - [`docs/`](./docs): the source of the documentation site - [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute to Monty and which contributions we currently accept Monty runs [Code Mode](https://pydantic.dev/docs/ai/harness/code-mode/) in [Pydantic AI](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai). Community bindings: [gomonty](https://github.com/ewhauser/gomonty/) (Go) and [dart_monty](https://github.com/runyaga/dart_monty) (Dart / Flutter). ## Part of the Pydantic Stack The Pydantic Stack is everything you need to ship production-grade AI agents: - [Pydantic AI](https://pydantic.dev/pydantic-ai?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=monty) - Type-safe agent framework - [Pydantic Logfire](https://pydantic.dev/logfire?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=monty) - AI-first, full-stack observability - [Logfire AI Gateway](https://pydantic.dev/ai-gateway?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=monty) - Unified LLM proxy
